description:
As an operator choosing the system default model, and a person chatting
  I want a change of model to apply to the next answer without a restart,
  and to see which model answered, why, and since when
  So that I can trust the model I chose is the model that served the reply

elements.name: A reply already being written finishes on the model it started with

steps.name: the stub providers "openai", "bdd-provider-b" and "bdd-provider-c" are configured with models "gpt-5.4-mini", "claude-5-sonnet, claude-5-haiku" and "qwen-5-turbo"
the system default model is "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
the stub supports "hold_content"
a conversation "Chat Y" with no model override
5 seconds have passed since the system default was set
I send the message "S1 r6 hold" without waiting for the reply
the stub for "openai" is holding the reply to "S1 r6 hold"
the operator changes the system default to "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku" from another page
the reply to "S1 r6 hold" is still held and the stop control is still visible
the held reply is released
the reply to "S1 r6 hold" finishes with content containing "bdd-reply-gpt-5.4-mini"
the reply to "S1 r6 hold" came from "openai/gpt-5.4-mini" with exactly one request
the answer's receipt names "openai/gpt-5.4-mini" and the origin "system default"
the answer's receipt shows the time the system default became "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
the answer's receipt does not show the time the system default became "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
I send the message "S1 r6 next"
the reply to "S1 r6 next" came from "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
